summary: Re-tested Dashboard MoodChart guarded lookup fix after iter-5 crash. All critical checks PASS. Mobile 390x844 /dashboard renders fully with NO runtime error overlay; scrollWidth==390 on main dashboard AND on all 5 tabs (tab-wall, tab-journal, tab-breath, tab-guardians, tab-memory). Mood orb shows EXACTLY 3 buttons (grounded/hopeful/struggling); need_help and no_talk absent. mood-rhythm-chart renders 14 cells with computed gridTemplateColumns of 7 tracks (grid-cols-7, 2 rows). Legacy 'need_help' pulse from DB renders as ORANGE cell rgb(247,181,87) (#F7B557) via the ?.color || '#C1521E' fallback — no crash. anchor-link-card, break-glass-card, break-glass-trigger, sos-988-btn, log-pulse-btn all present on mobile. Log-pulse flow: mood-select-grounded → log-pulse-btn clicked successfully (no error, no overlay). Tablet 768x1024 and desktop 1920x900 dashboard: no overflow, no error overlay, two-column layout intact on desktop. /dashboard/health regression OK (My Anchor hub visible). Landing pillar-core-layer visible with My Anchor / Medical Translator / Déjà entries. The iter-5 blocker is fully resolved.

integration_issues.issue: log-pulse-btn click succeeded with no error, but no Sonner/toast element was detected in DOM immediately after (queried role=status and class*=toast). Could be timing (toast dismissed quickly) or a different toast library selector. Pulse likely persisted (no error), but visual toast confirmation not verified via automation. Minor / non-blocking.

action_items: (Optional) Confirm the success toast component/library used after log-pulse — add a stable data-testid like log-pulse-toast for automation.

(Optional) Consider a one-time DB migration to remap legacy need_help/no_talk pulses to 'struggling' so the orange fallback cells no longer appear as an unexplained state to users; UI fallback should remain as defense-in-depth.
critical_code_review_comments: Fix is correct and minimal: `MOOD_STATES[d.state]?.color || '#C1521E'` handles legacy states as orange and missing state as empty gray via the outer ternary. Recommend extracting to a shared helper `getMoodColor(state)` in a moodStates.js module so Dashboard.jsx and MoodPulseOrb.jsx don't diverge again on any future enum change.
Same class of bug (unguarded object lookup on DB-provided keys) could exist elsewhere — worth a grep for `MOOD_STATES[` and any similar enum→config maps.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of critical checks passed; 1 minor unverified (toast visual)

rca of the issue: Previous iter-5 crash was due to unguarded MOOD_STATES[d.state].color lookup for legacy state 'need_help' (which was removed from the enum). The applied fix `MOOD_STATES[d.state]?.color || '#C1521E'` now returns an orange fallback for unknown states and (via outer ternary) a gray empty color when d.state is falsy. Verified in production DOM: a cell with rgb(247,181,87) (#F7B557 / orange family) is present alongside the current struggling state color, and no React error overlay is triggered.
